description: Estimate US federal + state quarterly estimated tax payments for a self-employed person. Given annual Schedule C net profit, filing status, two-letter US state code, tax year, and whether the §199A QBI deduction applies, returns annual federal income+SE tax, rough state income tax, SE tax, combined total, the per-quarter installment amount (4 equal payments), and a deep link that opens the site calculator pre-filled with these inputs. Read-only calculation; no data is stored.

filingStatus.description: Federal filing status: single, mfj (married filing jointly), hoh (head of household).

includeQBI.description: Whether the §199A qualified business income deduction applies (default true).

netProfit.description: Annual self-employment net profit in USD.

taxYear.description: Tax year for the federal rules applied.

name: estimateQuarterlyTax
